scope: Retrospective descriptive diagnostics of saved predictions; no predictive model retraining or inference
covariates: MW, prepared formal-charge sign indicators, observed potency, fold; assay SE in sensitivity
analyses: Spearman and partial rank correlations residualized by least squares; crossed MW<200 vs >=200, prepared charged vs net-neutral, observed pEC50<4 vs >=4 strata; all saved test compounds
interpretation: Associations, not causal charge/size effects; potency is an observed-label diagnostic covariate, not a deployable input; small strata retained with counts; native feature analysis separately provenance-bound
